title: Functor-square tower coherence descends from representatives
statement: Let R_i,D_i,C_i (i=0,1,2) be categories, q_i:R_i→D_i, k:R_0→R_1, h:R_1→R_2, m:R_0→R_2, and κ:k⋙h≅m. Let A:D_0→D_1, B:D_1→D_2, C:D_0→D_2 with a:A⋙B≅C; let F:C_0→C_1, G:C_1→C_2, H:C_0→C_2 with b:F⋙G≅H. Let T_i:D_i→C_i and t_i:R_i→C_i with r_i:q_i⋙T_i≅t_i. Fix η:q_0⋙A≅k⋙q_1, θ:q_1⋙B≅h⋙q_2, ζ:q_0⋙C≅m⋙q_2, component families c_P:F(t_0 P)→t_1(kP) and e_P:H(t_0 P)→t_2(mP) for P in R_0, and d_Q:G(t_1 Q)→t_2(hQ) for Q in R_1, and isomorphisms α:T_0⋙F≅A⋙T_1, β:T_1⋙G≅B⋙T_2, γ:T_0⋙H≅C⋙T_2. Suppose restriction along q_0 from D_0→C_2 to R_0→C_2 is faithful. Suppose the three normalized squares are F(r_0,P);c_P=α_(q_0 P);T_1(η_P);r_1,kP and its analogous formulas for β,d,θ and γ,e,ζ. Suppose B(η_P);θ_kP;q_2(κ_P)=a_(q_0 P);ζ_P and G(c_P);d_kP;t_2(κ_P)=b_(t_0 P);e_P for every P in R_0. Then for every K in D_0, G(α_K);β_(A K);T_2(a_K)=b_(T_0 K);γ_K. All displayed components of isomorphisms mean their forward maps. The component families need no separate naturality hypotheses.

proof.text: Restrict both natural transformations to representatives. Precompose by the image of the inverse first representative isomorphism, and postcompose by the last scalar and operation representative isomorphisms. Naturality of beta moves the first scalar representative comparison through the second square. Apply the three square normalizations, input associator compatibility, and representative tower coherence. Naturality of the output associator and cancellation of the representative isomorphisms identify the restricted routes. Faithfulness of precomposition gives equality of the original natural transformations.

theorem functorSquareTowerDescent
    {R₀ R₁ R₂ D₀ D₁ D₂ C₀ C₁ C₂ : Type*}
    [Category R₀] [Category R₁] [Category R₂]
    [Category D₀] [Category D₁] [Category D₂]
    [Category C₀] [Category C₁] [Category C₂]
    (q₀ : R₀ ⥤ D₀) (q₁ : R₁ ⥤ D₁) (q₂ : R₂ ⥤ D₂)
    (k : R₀ ⥤ R₁) (h : R₁ ⥤ R₂) (m : R₀ ⥤ R₂) (κ : k ⋙ h ≅ m)
    (A : D₀ ⥤ D₁) (B : D₁ ⥤ D₂) (C : D₀ ⥤ D₂) (a : A ⋙ B ≅ C)
    (F : C₀ ⥤ C₁) (G : C₁ ⥤ C₂) (H : C₀ ⥤ C₂) (b : F ⋙ G ≅ H)
    (T₀ : D₀ ⥤ C₀) (T₁ : D₁ ⥤ C₁) (T₂ : D₂ ⥤ C₂)
    (t₀ : R₀ ⥤ C₀) (t₁ : R₁ ⥤ C₁) (t₂ : R₂ ⥤ C₂)
    (r₀ : q₀ ⋙ T₀ ≅ t₀) (r₁ : q₁ ⋙ T₁ ≅ t₁) (r₂ : q₂ ⋙ T₂ ≅ t₂)
    (η : q₀ ⋙ A ≅ k ⋙ q₁) (θ : q₁ ⋙ B ≅ h ⋙ q₂) (ζ : q₀ ⋙ C ≅ m ⋙ q₂)
    (c : ∀ P, F.obj (t₀.obj P) ⟶ t₁.obj (k.obj P))
    (d : ∀ P, G.obj (t₁.obj P) ⟶ t₂.obj (h.obj P))
    (e : ∀ P, H.obj (t₀.obj P) ⟶ t₂.obj (m.obj P))
    (α : T₀ ⋙ F ≅ A ⋙ T₁) (β : T₁ ⋙ G ≅ B ⋙ T₂) (γ : T₀ ⋙ H ≅ C ⋙ T₂)
    (ff : ((Functor.whiskeringLeft R₀ D₀ C₂).obj q₀).Faithful)
    (hα : ∀ P, F.map (r₀.hom.app P) ≫ c P =
      α.hom.app (q₀.obj P) ≫ T₁.map (η.hom.app P) ≫ r₁.hom.app (k.obj P))
    (hβ : ∀ P, G.map (r₁.hom.app P) ≫ d P =
      β.hom.app (q₁.obj P) ≫ T₂.map (θ.hom.app P) ≫ r₂.hom.app (h.obj P))
    (hγ : ∀ P, H.map (r₀.hom.app P) ≫ e P =
      γ.hom.app (q₀.obj P) ≫ T₂.map (ζ.hom.app P) ≫ r₂.hom.app (m.obj P))
    (hη : ∀ P, B.map (η.hom.app P) ≫ θ.hom.app (k.obj P) ≫ q₂.map (κ.hom.app P) =
      a.hom.app (q₀.obj P) ≫ ζ.hom.app P)
    (hc : ∀ P, G.map (c P) ≫ d (k.obj P) ≫ t₂.map (κ.hom.app P) =
      b.hom.app (t₀.obj P) ≫ e P) :
    ∀ K, G.map (α.hom.app K) ≫ β.hom.app (A.obj K) ≫ T₂.map (a.hom.app K) =
      b.hom.app (T₀.obj K) ≫ γ.hom.app K
